record.oneLiner: HubSpot provides a broad REST API and official MCP servers for CRM and marketing automation integration using OAuth2 or private app API keys.
record.verdictReason: HubSpot offers a fully featured, self-service developer environment with free test accounts, comprehensive REST APIs, private app tokens, OAuth2, and even official first-party MCP servers.

evidence.quote: Once you’ve set up an OAuth backend, you can make API requests using the OAuth access token that corresponds to a user who installed your app. This access token is provided using the `Bearer` HTTP authorization header.
- Developer API keys created within your app developer account.

You can create up to 10 test accounts to test apps and integrations without affecting any real HubSpot data. Developer test accounts are free HubSpot accounts with access to a 90-day trial of many enterprise features
You cannot use service keys to authenticate webhooks, make calls within a UI extension, or leverage other developer platform functionality other than making REST API requests.
HubSpot offers two distinct MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — one for connecting any MCP-compatible AI tool or agent to your CRM, and one for building on the HubSpot Developer Platform.
